evidence: Additive after 0077: no table, column or applied migration is removed or rewritten; the code at 19dd9c3 keeps working on the new schema. 0078 replaces platform.admin_set_control with the same signature and result, qualifying the table columns its RETURNS TABLE names made ambiguous (every call failed with 42702), validating the key by its platform.control_settings row, and granting platform.admin_list_controls and platform.admin_set_control to hid_identity_runtime and hid_schema_test_runtime where those roles exist. 0079 replaces audit.list_platform_events with the same signature and result, selecting event.patient_id so each column lands in its declared position (the call failed with 42804). runtime-grants.sql adds the same two grants as 0078 for a later role bootstrap; the release does not apply it. Built 0001-0079 on PostgreSQL 16 in production order (0001-0072, role bootstrap, then 0073-0079) and in new-installation order (0001-0079, then role bootstrap); every suite in services/ehr-api/database/tests and services/ehr-api/test/database passes, the two new suites fail at 0077 and pass at 0079, and the database-migration checks of production-backend-images.yml pass.
